__comment: ADAPT-019: AE2 meteorites are suppressed by emptying their biome tag through the remove field (NeoForge patch, TagFile.java). The values key is required by the codec even when empty. This file lives in the built-in pack ae2replacegen, which GT_API.onAddPackFinders attaches ONLY when ae2/ReplaceMeteoriteGeneration=true (GregTech.cfg): with a meteorite there is no bedrock vein of meteoric iron, without one the vein is there (Loader_Worldgen, same flag CS.AE2_REPLACE_METEORITE_GENERATION). The pack is placed at Pack.Position.TOP — after AE2's own datapack, otherwise remove stays silent. GT6 sources of certus: the quartzite layer and the quartz vein; the budding chain leaves together with the meteorite. Existing chunks are left alone.
